Version.ReleaseNotes: Elevarq packaging v1.4.0, bundling upstream pgagroal 2.1.0. Hardened shipped defaults: scram-sha-256 HBA source-address allowlist (no host all all all all catch-all), allow_unknown_users defaults to false, and a default-on Kubernetes NetworkPolicy. Non-root, multi-arch (linux/amd64 + linux/arm64) container with a Helm chart. Release notes: https://github.com/Elevarq/pgAgroal/releases/tag/v1.4.0

HelmDeliveryOptionDetails.Description: Production-hardened pgagroal connection pooler for PostgreSQL, delivered as a cosign-signed Helm chart. Hardened shipped defaults: a scram-sha-256 HBA source-address allowlist (no catch-all), allow_unknown_users disabled, and a default-on NetworkPolicy. Runs non-root (UID 1000) with all Linux capabilities dropped, a read-only root filesystem, and seccomp RuntimeDefault. Includes liveness/readiness probes, a PodDisruptionBudget, and an optional Prometheus metrics port. Bundles upstream pgagroal 2.1.0.
HelmDeliveryOptionDetails.UsageInstructions:
1. Authenticate Helm to the AWS Marketplace registry:
   aws ecr get-login-password --region <region> | helm registry login --username AWS --password-stdin 709825985650.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

2. Create a values file named pgagroal-values.yaml with the following contents (two-space indentation), pointing at your PostgreSQL backend. Credentials are required: the v1.4.0 default does not pass unknown users through to the backend.

   postgresql:
     host: <postgres-host>
     port: 5432
   credentials:
     username: <app-user>
     password: <app-password>

   To use an existing Secret instead of inline credentials, set credentials.existingSecret. If your EKS pod network is outside the RFC1918 ranges (e.g. a 100.64.0.0/10 secondary CIDR), also set pgagroal.hbaSource to that CIDR.

3. Install into your cluster:
   helm install pgagroal oci://709825985650.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/elevarq/elevarq-pgagroal-chart --version 1.4.0 -n pgagroal --create-namespace -f pgagroal-values.yaml

4. Point applications at the pgagroal Service on port 6432. A NetworkPolicy is enabled by default and admits same-namespace clients; for clients in another namespace, set networkPolicy.ingressNamespaceSelectors. Full configuration: https://elevarq.com/docs/pgagroal-container
